messages.text: If you're after something that stands on the floor, our top floor globe is the Annapolis 20-inch Illuminated Antique Floor Globe. It's a large, hand-assembled, made-in-USA heirloom piece with a raised relief antique map that glows when lit, set on a handcrafted hardwood stand — a true centrepiece for a study or living room. You'll find it under that exact name in the search bar, ready to add to your cart.
